_comment: Canonical terminology (approved by the project lead's standing instruction to decide autonomously, 2026-11-05). Policy: docs/08_TERMINOLOGY_POLICY.md. 'terms' are enforced by qa.py (MEDIUM finding when missing). Keys are matched as whole English words in the source.

decisions.Dragonborn: Translated by meaning (lore: born with the soul of a dragon); the Dragon-Language word Dovahkiin stays transliterated.
decisions.city names: Transliterated, not translated (Whiterun -> وايترن), to keep proper-noun identity.
decisions.Magicka: الطاقة السحرية: clearer for players than a transliteration.
decisions.harakat: UI text keeps only shadda (in-game: tanween on alef reads as hamza in the UI font); books keep harakat.
decisions.shouts: Shout names translated by meaning inside «» (e.g. «القوة الجارفة»); the Dragon-Language words (Fus Ro Dah) stay transliterated.
